What is Meridian Bojin Facial?

Instant face lift and radiance from TCM wisdom. This facial focuses on releasing stagnant energy along face meridian points with a buffalo horn. Areas that feel discomfort signify ‘problems’ and are given more attention to energize the meridian channels. Premium red ginseng and tang kwei are used for energy balancing. Well balanced energy flow rejuvenates cells and slows the aging process, improving the complexion and health.
Benefits of Meridian Bojin Facial
Face looks lifted and skin elasticity is improved
Increase circulation of “Qi” and blood flow throughout the face and body
Regulates “Yin” and “Yang” to moisten facial tissues and relieve tension
Reduces fine lines with application of acupressure points
Helps in relaxation, balancing and rejuvenation
Suitable For
Saggy skin or skin that has lost elasticity
Puffy skin (due to water retention)
Those wishing to do face contouring
Dull uneven skin
How Meridian Bojin Facial Works

• Special handcrafted buffalo horns are used in “Bo- Jin” massage to give an instant face lift.
  • The meridian points on the face are connected to your organs through meridian channels. Stimulating meridian points helps to balance energy to support healing the body naturally.
  • Energized meridian channels rejuvenate cells and slow the aging process.
  • Lymphatic face and shoulder massage to aid relaxation and lymph flow for skin detoxification.
  • Premium Red Ginseng is used for these beauty benefits:
    • Reduces appearance of wrinkles and fine lines
    • Tightens the skin
      Brightens skin tone
    • Protects the skin from free radicals and environmental damage.
  • EGF Booster Capsule is used to accelerate skin’s healing and rejuvenation.
  • Tang Kwei Premium Mask – a powerful antioxidant and energy booster that helps to address blemishes while enhancing skin for a more vibrant tone.
